title: Gil Kane
description: Han Solo appears to be defying the laws of physics in a rendering by Gil Kane that captures the outrageous-but-alwavs-entertaining sprint of the STAR WARS movies themselves. Kane's career in comics spans six decades. Over the years he's drawn just about every major character in the DC and Marvel Universes and recently embarked on his first assignment for Topps Comics, the official adaptation ot Steven Spielberg's JURASSIC PARK
